title: Email: PUC Asks About PG-01 Re-energization; State and County Calls at 19:00

fields.to: Emergency Manager (EOC Command); Public Information Officer; Operations Director Rosalind Ames (rosalind.ames@foothillselectric.example)
fields.subject: FW: Foothills Electric PSPS 14 Apr — report of energization in an evacuation area + 3 incoming (DHSEM, CDPHE, neighboring county)
fields.body:
EOC Command, PIO, Co-op Operations:

Below are one email and three calls the message center received between 19:00 and 19:10. Each one is waiting for a reply.

1) EMAIL — 19:00 MDT
FROM: Utility Safety Section, Colorado PUC staff (utilitysafety@copuc.example)
TO: Operations Director Rosalind Ames (rosalind.ames@foothillselectric.example); eoc@sawmillcountyco.example
SUBJECT: Foothills Electric PSPS 14 Apr — report of energization in an evacuation area

"We received a media report that a Circuit 11 segment was re-energized in an area under Evacuation Warning. Please send us a preliminary notice tonight. Then include it in your post-event report: circuits, customers affected, medical baseline contacts (attempted and confirmed), notice times, duration and the re-energization event.
— Utility Safety Section, Colorado Public Utilities Commission staff"

2) PHONE — 19:04 MDT, Colorado DHSEM regional field manager, callback (303) 555-0147
"What's your shelter population and trend? Do you expect a state declaration or an FMAG request tonight?"
Shelter status at the time of the call: Pine Gulch High School has 268 registered, up from 212 at 17:00, and is 31 overnight cots short.

3) TECHNICAL UPDATE — 19:05 MDT, CDPHE smoke desk (SIMULATED AirNow DATA — EXERCISE)
Pine Gulch monitor: PM2.5 NowCast 142 µg/m³, AQI 196 (Unhealthy). It was AQI 174 at 16:00.
CDPHE has issued the smoke advisory for Sawmill County. The smoke desk is asking for the county's clean air shelter location so it can go into the advisory update. Callback (303) 555-0163.

4) PHONE — 19:10 MDT, Emergency Manager, neighboring plains county, callback (970) 555-0118
"About 140 vehicles from your foothills have come through our fairgrounds rest stop, and 22 households want to shelter here. Are they under an order? Which zones?"

Please tell the message center who is answering each item and by what time.
fields.signature:
EOC Message Center
Sawmill County Office of Emergency Management
Pine Gulch EOC, Level 2
eoc.messages@sawmillcountyco.example

instructorNote: This inject tests post-event accountability and how EOC Command handles a stack of requests. Watch for these steps: the co-op sends the PUC a preliminary notice and starts the data for co-op plan section 7, counting attempted and confirmed medical baseline contacts separately. EM gives DHSEM the shelter numbers and makes a declaration/FMAG decision through UC/DFPC. Someone names the Recreation Center as the clean air shelter for CDPHE. The neighboring county gets zone statuses with a time stamp, and the PIO's smoke message matches the advisory and the school and hospital actions.
